objective: Escort Rin'ji out of the Quel'Danil Lodge, then find his hidden secret at the Overlook Cliffs to the east.

description: Rin'ji lost axe and was captured! Please, help Rin'ji escape. Me know that <race> like you don't like Rin'ji's kind, but Rin'ji begs! Must get out of here!
Got something for nice <race> if he helps Rin'ji out of here/she helps Rin'ji out of here...
Rin'ji is hiding something secret at the Overlook Cliffs.
completion: This troll tablet must be the "secret" that Rin'ji was talking about.
Covered with strange markings, you can not decipher what the tablet says.
Oran Snakewrithe sent you to this area in the first place... Perhaps he might be able to tell you more about it.
